## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated reformatting or refactoring.
- [ ] User-facing strings use the existing i18n resources.
- [ ] File open/save changes include an appropriate round-trip or fidelity test.

- [ ] Public SDK/service/tool/lifecycle changes update the authoritative guide, examples and compatibility notes.
- [ ] Editor changes preserve host neutrality and document/selection permissions.
- [ ] Relevant package-consumer and host checks ran; skipped/unavailable targets are identified above.
- [ ] Applicable upstream notices and file-level modification notices are retained.
